name: ShopGaps Catalog Audit for WooCommerce
author: shopgaps

sections.description:
ShopGaps Catalog Audit lists WooCommerce products that are missing a featured image, SKU, or price so you can fix them before ads and search traffic hit incomplete listings.

Nothing in your catalog is sent to a third-party server by this plugin.

Checks included

  • Missing featured image
  • Missing SKU
  • Missing or zero price

A separate paid plugin with extra checks is sold at shopgaps.com. That code is not included here.

Privacy

Catalog data stays on your WordPress site. See https://shopgaps.com/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload this plugin and activate it.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Catalog Audit.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send my products off-site?

No. Queries run on your site. ShopGaps does not receive your catalog.

Where is Pro?

https://shopgaps.com — a separate plugin, not a license unlock in this copy.

Where do I get support?

Email info@shopgaps.com. After the plugin is listed, use the WordPress.org support forum.
